text_blocks.snippet: Yes, there are FDA-approved COVID-19 vaccines. Specifically, Comirnaty (Pfizer-BioNTech) and Spikevax (Moderna) have been fully approved for individuals 12 years of age and older. Additionally, the updated versions of these mRNA vaccines are authorized for individuals 6 months and older.

list.snippet: Comirnaty (Pfizer-BioNTech): Fully approved for individuals 12 years and older.
Spikevax (Moderna): Fully approved for individuals 12 years and older.

Updated mRNA vaccines (both Pfizer-BioNTech and Moderna): Authorized for individuals 6 months and older. These are the updated versions formulated to better protect against currently circulating variants.
